threat_event: Misuse of the shared OT remote access gateway changes treatment at a large water system
threat_source: Cybercriminal or state-sponsored actor using a stolen session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commissioning exception waives per-session approval for 34 Construction engineers; Construction laptops on the WTP-A maintenance segment without an interconnection agreement; recordings not reviewed
existing_controls: Gateway MFA and recording; hardwired feed limits; staffed control rooms
treatment_plan: Revoke the commissioning exception; per-session approval for everyone; review vendor and commissioning recordings weekly; interconnection agreement for SYS-C3; intercompany contract security terms

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared IT services into OT DMZs and division systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network hub, and data platform connect all divisions; acquired water systems have flat networks
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; Water Utility business networks; SYS-C1; SYS-E2
regulatory_driver: C-WATER-R01 (300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii)); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; state breach laws
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; immutable backups; OT DMZs at regional SCADA
treatment_plan: Segment acquired systems; quarterly restore tests; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses a public notice, DFARS, client, or SEC deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group notification matrix not exercised; each division has different clocks (24-hour Tier 1, 72-hour DFARS, client contracts, 4 business days after materiality)
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Attackers exploit the weak OT of the 19 acquired water systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy vendor remote tools and password-only VPNs; flat networks; shared HMI logins; no monitoring; no offline backups
treatment_plan: Integration program: remote access behind SYS-G4 by 2027-06-30; named accounts; segmentation; offline backups; monitoring; migration to regional SCADA by 2028
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: RRA and ERP certifications do not reflect real cyber risk across the 42 covered systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Each system certifies separately; 27 mid-size RRA reviews used a generic cyber checklist; ERPs due 2026-12-24
existing_controls: On-time certifications in both cycles; group RRA template
treatment_plan: Group cyber addendum method using the asset inventory and P01 results; revise the 27 ERPs by 2026-12-11

threat_event: Covered defense information is compromised or the CMMC affirmation is inaccurate, leading to DoD contract loss and legal exposure
threat_source: Adversary targeting defense facility data; internal process gap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI found outside the enclave; 2025 self-assessment recorded unmet requirements as MET
existing_controls: CUI enclave; SPRS posting; annual training
treatment_plan: CUI discovery and purge; correct the SPRS assessment before the 2026-12-12 affirmation; C3PAO readiness

threat_event: AI used in operational and client-facing work without validation or governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 live before validation; operators told to act on alerts; division AI uses not all inventoried

threat_event: Outage at a critical shared provider (cloud provider A, identity vendor, cellular carrier) hits several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-E1, the data platform, and the gateway broker all run in provider A; one carrier for most client gateways
treatment_plan: Second carrier for client gateways; documented provider failover runbook

threat_event: Controls assumed inherited from corporate are not operating in Construction and Environmental Services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented for the Water Utility only

threat_event: Compromise of the group identity platform gives access across all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity platform for 45,000 users and OT MFA federation
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; identity threat detection
treatment_plan: Extend phishing-resistant MFA to all OT and gateway users

threat_event: An insider misuses privileged OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged OT accounts vaulted, but session review is sampled
affected_asset_or_process: OT at all regional SCADA systems
existing_controls: PAM checkout; background checks; same-day termination
treatment_plan: Monthly review of privileged OT sessions

threat_event: The SOC cannot see attacks on most water systems' OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT sensors at the 6 largest systems only (not WTP-C)
existing_controls: SOC monitors IT and gateway logs
treatment_plan: Sensors at WTP-C and the 9 systems serving 50,000 to 99,999 by 2027-06-30, then acquired systems

threat_event: A major hurricane causes outages at many water systems and job sites at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida headquarters and southeastern service area; staff are also affected
treatment_plan: Cross-division storm staffing plan; fuel contracts reviewed each May

threat_event: Customer personal information is exposed through a vendor breach
threat_source: Criminal actor at a SaaS vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1.21 million customer accounts in the CIS vendor's SaaS
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 review; contract notice terms
treatment_plan: Cyber insurance; vendor notice within 10 days (Florida third-party agent rule) written into the contract

threat_event: The annual Item 106 description overstates OT security maturity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure drafted from IT program descriptions
treatment_plan: Group OT Security Director reviews the OT statements in the draft

threat_event: Compromised OT vendor software or firmware is installed across many systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common SCADA platform across 14 regional systems
existing_controls: Authorized channels; integrity checks of PLC logic
treatment_plan: Hash verification of vendor packages before deployment

threat_event: Division supplements drift from group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Construction supplement predates the CUI enclave; Environmental Services supplement missing

threat_event: Cyber insurance does not cover OT physical damage or public notice costs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Policy wording written for IT incidents
treatment_plan: Negotiate OT and public-notice coverage at the 2027 renewal
